purpose: Estimate split sensitivity of three already deployed autonomous choices. Read members from each signed full-training autonomous run and preserve their recorded uniform probability vote. Keep them fixed before generating any new fold. Reuse the fourth distinct component per fold across all recipes.
randomization: Generate two independent deterministic splitter seeds using the first eight hex digits of SHA256 of AIAA3102 paired-development new allocation v1/<index>, using literal indices 1 and 2. Apply shuffled StratifiedGroupKFold with five folds on the complete 8301 training rows and shared-text connected components. Each row is held once per seed. Check that no component crosses a boundary and none of the new folds duplicate an earlier fold.
evaluation: One classifier fit per distinct component per fold, at most 40, zero paid API. Report absolute correct counts, each fold's paired gains and losses, and per-seed pooled results on 8301 distinct rows. The same training rows are revisited for the second seed; do not count them as fresh independent examples or use repetitions to inflate significance. Training rows are the only source and outcomes do not change the already committed production policy. In a separate diagnostic quantify when both members miss together and a third frozen candidate corrects them. Do not optimize any weights or select a new ensemble on these outer predictions.
protection: No released validation labels, course test, H2 or model API requests. No external score enters the scheduling, training, fixed recipes or voting.
